items.title: How Claude's Text Watermarking Works
items.content: Short illustration of how Claude's text watermarking is supposed to work based on Anthropic's released materials.
items.contentSnippet: Short illustration of how Claude's text watermarking is supposed to work based on Anthropic's released materials.

summaries.zh: "基于Anthropic发布的资料，本文通过简图展示了Claude文本水印的工作原理。该技术旨在为文本添加不可见的水印，以追踪内容的来源和传播路径，确保文本的完整性和可信度。通过这种方式，可以防止未经授权的复制和篡改，保护原创内容。"
summaries.en: Claude's text watermarking, as described by Anthropic, involves embedding hidden markers within generated text. These watermarks are designed to be imperceptible to readers but identifiable through specific algorithms. The technology aims to track the origin of AI-generated content, aiding in detection and attribution. The process is illustrated in Anthropic's released materials, demonstrating its intended functionality. The system relies on subtle modifications to text that are invisible to humans but detectable by trained models. This approach supports efforts to verify AI-generated content while maintaining readability.

items.content: Using Open-Weight Models in Local Coding Harnesses as an Alternative to Claude Code and Codex Subscriptions
items.contentSnippet: Using Open-Weight Models in Local Coding Harnesses as an Alternative to Claude Code and Codex Subscriptions

summaries.zh: 本文探讨了使用本地编码工具中的开源重量模型替代Claude Code和Codex订阅的方法。通过在本地环境中部署Open-Weight模型，开发者可以减少对商业订阅的依赖，同时保持高效的代码生成能力。这种方法为编程任务提供了灵活且成本效益高的解决方案。
summaries.en: The article discusses using open-weight models in local coding harnesses as an alternative to Claude Code and Codex subscriptions. It highlights the benefits of deploying local coding agents with open-weight models, offering flexibility and cost-efficiency compared to cloud-based subscriptions. The focus is on leveraging local resources for coding tasks while maintaining performance. The content emphasizes the practicality of this approach for developers seeking自主 control over their tools.

items.title: GLM-5.2 and IndexShare for Long-Context Sparse Attention
items.content: How GLM-5.2 uses IndexShare to reuse sparse-attention token selections across layers and reduce long-context indexer computation.
items.contentSnippet: How GLM-5.2 uses IndexShare to reuse sparse-attention token selections across layers and reduce long-context indexer computation.

summaries.zh: GLM-5.2是一款开源权重更新后的GLM模型，保留了GLM-5的稀疏MoE骨干结构，并引入了IndexShare技术，以降低1M token DSA推理的成本。该模型在长上下文处理中表现出色，通过优化注意力机制提高了效率。
summaries.en: GLM-5.2 is an open-weight update to the GLM-5 model, retaining its sparse MoE backbone while introducing IndexShare. This enhancement enables more cost-effective 1M-token DSA inference. The summary focuses on the key modifications and their benefits for efficient long-context processing.
